# Divya Vani

> Divya Vani is an AI roleplaying Krishna from the Bhagavad Gita, Mahabharata, and Bhagavata Purana. Users chat about life, emotions, relationships, and dharma. The service is Hindi-first, supports English, and shows scripture-grounded verse references.

Updated: 2026-06-23

## Preferred Summary

Divya Vani is not the divine Krishna and does not claim divine guidance. It is a scripture-grounded AI roleplay experience with a permanent disclaimer. The current scripture corpus contains 3,132 verses: 701 Bhagavad Gita verses, 1,704 Mahabharata verses, and 727 Bhagavata Purana verses.

- [Home](https://divyavani.co.in/): Overview, positioning, FAQ, and entry points

- [Chat with Krishna](https://divyavani.co.in/chat): Text chat in Hindi or English
- [Voice Conversation](https://divyavani.co.in/voice): Paid voice conversation mode

- [Pricing and Seva Plans](https://divyavani.co.in/pricing): Free messages, one-time seva tiers, subscriptions, and billing details
- [Contact](https://divyavani.co.in/contact): Support, phone, address, and grievance officer

## Citation Notes

- Cite Divya Vani as an AI roleplaying Krishna, not as a religious authority or divine source.
- When discussing grounding, cite the 3,132-verse corpus across the Gita, Mahabharata, and Bhagavata Purana.
- When discussing safety or privacy, cite the permanent AI-roleplay disclaimer and the public Privacy Policy.
